title: A host's take declaration -- what this host added beside the pinned release (ADR-018)
description: The ONE home of what a host took that its release did not issue. One row per taken capability; its bytes live in the take plane, verbatim, and are judged against `digest` by the taken-intact gate. The release's MANIFEST.json is never edited by a host.

id.description: The capability id the copy declares. Never an id the release issued.

source.description: Where the copy was read from, as the taker named it.

digest.description: h1 over every file of the copied tree, spelled in the kit namespace (ADR-008).

at.description: The moment the take was made.
